assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Two intersecting circles with centres O1 (radius 10) and O2 (radius 7.5) and common chord AB (vertical, A at the top); the segment O1O2 crosses AB with parts 8 and 4.5, and half the chord is 6; the red segment EF through A is parallel to O1O2, with E on the left circle and F on the right one, and the dashed perpendiculars from O1 and O2 meet it at M and N.

difficulty_rationale: The key insight is that EF is twice the projection of the segment of centres onto the line, which needs the chord-bisecting property; the computation is then short.
